newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian savings double to 15 bln dinars in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algerian savings double to 15 bln dinars in 1996.

text.p: Algeria's household savings doubled in 1996 to reach 15 billion dinars ($267 million) from 7.5 billion dinars in 1995, the finance minister said on Tuesday.
The state-owned savings bank, La Caisse Nationale d'Epargne et de Prevoyance (CNEP), received the savings from families, said Abdelkrim Harchaoui, quoted by the official Algerian news agency APS.

"This improvement was due to households' increased savings," he said without giving a background for increased savings amid Algeria's economic crisis, during which the government said it had cut people's purchasing power in 1996. ($1 = 56 dinars)
